request.problem: Testing each Persona Skill manually makes isolated regression checks slow and inconsistent.
request.desired_outcome: A reusable runner that tests one Persona–Skill pair per fresh low-reasoning task, checks the response, records sanitized evidence, and archives the temporary task.
non_goals: Changing canonical Persona or Skill records
constraints: Use current canonical Persona and Skill data
success_criteria: One case is generated for each selected live Persona–Skill pair
A fresh low-reasoning task can be created and archived per case
Responses are evaluated against Skill-specific quality signals
Sanitized results can be scanned locally
request.stopping_condition: The package, evaluator, smoke-test evidence, validation, and limitations are linked from the Work Order.

participants.responsibility: Confirm the existing eval and Skill package boundaries
Coordinate isolated task creation, bounded batches, waits, result capture, and archive cleanup
Review result quality and keep structural validity separate from independent conformance
Check task isolation, tool availability, permissions, and safe fallback behavior

decision_rights.implementation: Codex within the authorized repository scope

evidence.supports: Existing normalized conformance and result-evaluation foundation
Current live Personas and Persona-specific Skill applications
Task creation, waiting, reading, and archiving path

contributions.finding: Extend the existing eval workflow and add one flat callable orchestration Skill; do not create a new library space or canonical Persona record.
tradeoffs_or_risks: Runtime task access varies by surface.
contributions.recommended_action: Keep the matrix and evaluator file-based and make live task execution an adapter path.

contributions.finding: One fresh task per Persona–Skill case removes conversation carryover and makes task lifecycle inspectable.
tradeoffs_or_risks: A full matrix can create many temporary tasks.
contributions.recommended_action: Use bounded batches, low reasoning, and archive-after-capture.

contributions.finding: Response-contract validity, Skill quality evidence, task lifecycle, and independent observation must remain separate signals.
tradeoffs_or_risks: A same-runtime runner cannot establish independent conformance by itself.
contributions.recommended_action: Record observer status and use UNKNOWN when independent observation is unavailable.

contributions.finding: A missing task, Tool, permission, or archive operation is an access or cleanup condition, not a successful test result.
tradeoffs_or_risks: Projectless tasks cannot inspect repository context unless it is explicitly injected.
contributions.recommended_action: Record the exact condition and return a bounded fallback matrix.

decisions.summary: Use eval/ for matrix, fixtures, result checks, and isolated evidence; use a flat .agents/skills/persona-skill-conformance package for task orchestration.
Each case loads exactly one live Persona and one Skill in a fresh task; shared context and unrelated records are excluded.
Archive temporary tasks after capture. Individual task or message deletion is not part of the current tool contract.

artifacts.provenance: Existing eval contract plus user request

accepted_facts: Existing eval/ foundation can be extended
open_questions: Whether the live task smoke test can complete on this host
handoffs.blockers_or_fallback: Use matrix generation and recorded-result evaluation when live task access is unavailable.

accepted_facts: Matrix derives from canonical live records
open_questions: Independent observer availability for future runs
handoffs.blockers_or_fallback: Mark observer unknown when the runner and observer share a runtime.

gates.note: The package derives 94 cases, the evaluator passes the sanitized smoke result, and a fresh low-reasoning task completed and archived. The first prompt edge case was contained and the retry contract corrected it.

open_questions: Should selected Skill overrides be expanded for high-risk or Tool-dependent capabilities?
Should future runs add an independently available Noor observer task?
next_action: Invoke the Skill for a selected Persona–Skill scope or the full 94-case matrix.

solution.summary: The isolated runner package derives and evaluates Persona–Skill cases, creates fresh low-reasoning Codex tasks when available, captures responses, and archives temporary tasks. One live smoke result is recorded; independent observer conformance remains unknown.

user_authorized: Build the isolated Persona–Skill test runner
Use fresh low-reasoning tasks and archive them after capture

revisions.change: Initialized the scoped context for the isolated Persona–Skill runner.
Completed the package, matrix evaluator, live low-reasoning smoke test, archive cleanup, validation, and bounded reconciliation; preserved the initial prompt edge case and observer uncertainty.
